image_domain.note: PGD eps/alpha are specified and applied in this [0,1] domain (eps=8/255=0.0314, alpha=2/255=0.0078), matching the existing pgd_robustness_grid*.py scripts.

channel_structure.NSLSR: 3-channel RGB JPEG, all 3 channels bit-identical (single-band SWIR replicated to 3ch)
channel_structure.RASMD: 3-channel RGB JPEG, all 3 channels bit-identical (single-band SWIR replicated to 3ch)
channel_structure.implication: Any SWIR-specific attack (SNUA column gain/offset, ARIA radiometric field) must be applied identically across all 3 channels to remain physically meaningful as a single-band sensor perturbation -- NOT allowed to diverge per-channel, since that would simulate an RGB sensor artifact instead of a SWIR one.

gradient_path.method: detector.train() with BN layers forced to .eval() (matches existing PGD script's approach), detector.args converted from checkpoint dict to ultralytics.cfg.get_cfg() Namespace (required -- raw dict lacks .box/.cls/.dfl attributes the loss function reads), forward(batch_dict) then returns (loss_sum_tensor[3], loss_detach[3]) tuple pre-NMS.
gradient_path.gotcha_confirmed: Passing detector.args as a raw dict (as loaded from checkpoint) crashes the loss call ('dict' object has no attribute 'box') -- must convert via get_cfg(overrides=...) first. This was NOT needed in the eval-only PGD scripts because those never called .loss(), only forward-then-postprocess in eval mode.
